goal: Review the uncommitted local diff vs HEAD on the bakeoff plugin for correctness defects in production code and supporting tests.
background: Review target: uncommitted working-tree changes (git diff HEAD).
Changed files (tracked, modified), paths relative to bakeoff/ context root:
Diff size: ~221 lines across 5 files; internal/manifest/manifest.go is the primary code change, internal/manifest/manifest_test.go is a substantial test expansion.

Companion lenses run separately: telemetry-schema (manifest schema/contract) and docs-tests (doc accuracy + test coverage). This lens focuses ONLY on correctness defects in code, not schema design or doc quality.
Known context: untracked work-order files in cwd reference 'manifest-telemetry-highest-severity' work, indicating the manifest change likely surfaces a highest-severity telemetry field.

facet.focus: Find correctness defects, edge cases, and regressions introduced by the manifest.go and doctor_test.go changes.
include: logic bugs, off-by-one errors, ordering/sorting mistakes, and incorrect comparisons in manifest.go
nil, empty-slice, and zero-value handling in new manifest fields and helpers
race conditions, mutation of shared state, or unsafe concurrent access
error handling regressions: swallowed errors, wrong error types, missing wrap
regressions in existing manifest behavior exposed by the diff
test correctness: assertions that pass for the wrong reason, missing comparisons, hard-coded values that drift from production code
exclude: telemetry schema/contract design critique (covered by telemetry-schema lens)
doc prose accuracy critique (covered by docs-tests lens)
test coverage gaps unless they hide an active defect
style-only preferences without project convention evidence
